title: Data Analyst
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of an innovative technology and engineering business based in Bristol. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic and capable Data Analyst to join its growing data team.


This is a fantastic role for someone earlier in their analytics career who wants to develop quickly in a supportive, forward-thinking environment. You will work across product, operations and commercial data, building reports and analysis that help the business understand its customers and improve its services. The company has a strong learning culture, modern tooling and a genuine commitment to developing its people.


This is an excellent opportunity for an analyst who wants variety, mentoring and the chance to grow with a business that is investing heavily in data, in one of the UK's most liveable cities.


Please note: This role is exclusively recruited for via Consula. Applications made outside of Consula will not be considered and cannot progress. To apply, you must submit your application through the Consula platform.


Location: Bristol


Key Responsibilities


• Build and maintain reports and dashboards used across the business.

• Analyse product usage, customer and operational data to answer business questions.

• Write SQL queries to extract and prepare data from the company data platform.

• Support the senior analysts on larger projects and deep-dive analysis.

• Help define and track KPIs with teams across the business.

• Contribute to data quality checks and documentation.

• Present findings clearly and confidently to colleagues at all levels.

• Learn and apply new tools and techniques as the data function grows.


A Typical Day


You might start with the team stand-up, agreeing the day's priorities, before spending the morning building a dashboard for the product team's next release review. After lunch you could be paired with a senior analyst on a customer churn analysis, then finish the day tidying documentation or learning a new feature of the BI tool. You will be supported, stretched and encouraged every step of the way.


What We Are Looking For


• Some experience in a data analyst, reporting or insight role — or strong relevant placement/graduate experience.

• Good SQL and Excel skills; exposure to a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau.

• A curious, analytical mindset and genuine enthusiasm for working with data.

• Good attention to detail and a willingness to learn.

• Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach.

• Exposure to Python or R is a bonus but by no means essential.

• Bristol-based or able to commute to the office regularly.


What You Can Expect


• Hybrid working with genuine flexibility.

• 28 days' annual leave including bank holidays.

• Structured mentoring and a personal development budget.

• A modern, friendly office in the heart of Bristol.

• Competitive benefits package including pension and wellbeing support.

• A collaborative culture with regular team events and a genuine commitment to work-life balance.


This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.


How to Apply


Submit your application through Consula, including a brief summary of your analytics experience and the tools you work with day to day. We will be in touch with shortlisted applicants promptly to discuss the role and next steps. Please note applications made outside of Consula will not be considered.
